description: Call with baseline true before changing the code, and without it before saying the change is done. The plan file lists the checks that prove the change. Verify reruns them, compares the runs with the baseline, and scans the lines changed since the plan base for suspects. VERIFIED needs every check improved or clean with complete runs on both sides, and no suspect on a changed line; otherwise the reasons say what to resolve. Do not call a change done while it is NOT_VERIFIED.

baseline.description: Record the runs from before the change instead of verifying it.

plan.description: The plan file, relative to the working directory. Default: .recovery-probe/verify.json.

name: verify_change
title: Verify a code change with before and after evidence
